fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Examination Regulation Authority Allahabad Uttar Pradesh has released the notification for the Examination of UP BTC/ DELED Admission 2026. Candidates Can Also Check All Details on Official , Online applying process for UP Deled Admission 2026 has started on 15 June 2026 & the candidates can apply till 08 July 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UP Deled Admission 2026 Online Form which has given below.

UP DELEd 2026

UP DELEd Admission Online Form 2026

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 June 2026
  • Last Date : 08 July 2026
  • Last Date Fee Payment : 09 July 2026
  • Last Date Re-Print Form : 11 July 2026
  • Rank Card : Will Be Updated Here Soon

Application Fee

  • General / OBC : Rs. 700/-
  • SC / ST : Rs. 500 /-
  • PH : Rs. 200 /-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

UP DELEd Notification 2026 : Age Limit as on 01 July 2026.

  • Minimum Age : 18 Years
  • Maximum Age : 35 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per UP Deled Rules.
  • Use Tool –

UP DELEd Application Form 2026 : Educational Qualification

  • Candidates Must Have Bachelor’s Degree in any stream with a minimum of 50% marks. For SC/ST candidates, a minimum of 45% marks is required.
  • All candidates must thoroughly read the official notification before applying

UP DELEd Online Form 2026 : Mode of Selection

  • Rank Card

UP DELEd Online Form 2026 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://updeled.gov.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the UP DELEd before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Notification Here –
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for UP DELEd Online Form can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
  • Note – छात्रो से ये अनुरोध किया जाता है की वो अपना फॉर्म भरने से पहले Official Notification (Last Date, Age Limit, Qualification) को ध्यान से जरूर पढे उसके बाद ही अपना फॉर्म भरे ।

Answer. The last date to apply online for this recruitment is 08 July 2026.

Q. What is Age Limit For UP DELEd 2026 Online Form?
Answer. The age of the candidates applying for this recruitment as per UP DELEd rules, see the age information in the official information.

Answer. To apply for this recruitment, the candidates must have Bachelor’s Degree In any stream with a minimum of 50% Marks. For SC/ST Candidates, A Minimum of 45% Marks is required.
